name: tokentoll
description: Reviews tokentoll's two analysis tools: scan estimates the monthly cost of LLM API calls found in a codebase, and diff compares those costs between two git refs. Both can fetch LiteLLM pricing data on first use and write it to the ~/.tokentoll cache, so both keep Guard's usual handling. Off until you turn it on.
saferAlternatives: scan and diff read source and git history without modifying the checkout; on first use they download LiteLLM pricing data and cache it under ~/.tokentoll, so pre-populate that cache to avoid network access.
